tool_input.content:
import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('init.xlsx')
ws = wb['BZTB']
out = wb['Tema UV COS']
rows=[]
for r in range(1, ws.max_row+1):
    b = ws.cell(r,2).value
    if b and (str(b).startswith('COS Pass') or str(b).startswith('COS Comm') or str(b).startswith('COS W/S')) and 'Used' in str(b):
        if str(b) != 'COS Pass  - A Used':
            rows.append((r, ws.cell(r,1).value, b, ws.cell(r,3).value, ws.cell(r,4).value))
for i,(r,a,b,c,d) in enumerate(rows):
    out.cell(i+1,1).value=a
    out.cell(i+1,2).value=b
    out.cell(i+1,3).value=c
    out.cell(i+1,4).value=d
wb.save('output.xlsx')
print(len(rows))
